capabilities.body: OpenAmer i dzudzanya mushumo, ya u ita nga zwishumiswa zwa vhukuma — theminali, tshiswaswari, faela na khoudu — ya vhulunga zwe zwa shuma.
capabilities.title: Muimeleli ane a humbula na inwi

capabilities.body: Nyambedzano, muhumbulo na modele zwi dzula kha uyu mutshini. A hu na tshine tsha rumelwa nṱha arali ni songo humbela.
capabilities.title: Zwishumiswa zwaṋu, datha yaṋu

capabilities.body: Nyambo dza 186, luṅwe na luṅwe nga maṅwalwa ane na a vhala. Tshikirini tsha u thoma tsha mbekanyamushumo tshi ni vhudzisa uri ni ṱoḓa lufhio.
capabilities.title: Luambo lwaṋu, nga nḓila yo teaho

capabilities.body: Vhukoni vhu vhulungwa kha mushumo une wa itwa, uri mishumo ya ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe i fhungudzee musi ni tshi bvela phanḓa na u i shumisa.
capabilities.title: Vhukoni vhune ha aluwa

help: Sedzani uri uyu mutshini u kona u swikelela inthanethe.
Itani nzudzanyo hafhu — maga o fhelaho ha nga dovhololwi.
Arali zwa kundelwa luvhili, vulani rekhodo; mitaladzi ya u fhedza i bula ḽiga.
failure.lead: A hu na tshanduko dzo humiselwa murahu hu songo ḓivhadzwa — OpenAmer i ima he ya guma hone, uri musi i tshi dovha ya tshimbidzwa i bvele phanḓa henefho.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer i kha ḓi vha kha lushaka lwa kale nahone i kha ḓi shuma. A hu na tsho tshintshiwaho nga hafu.
failure.title: Nzudzanyo a yo ngo fhela

language.lead: Nzudzanyo i bvela phanḓa nga luambo lune na khetha fhano. Ni nga lu shandula nga murahu kha mbekanyamushumo.
language.title: Khethani luambo lwaṋu

progress.lead: Nzudzanyo ya luthihi: OpenAmer i khou dzhenisa zwine ya zwi ṱoḓa na u dzudzanya uyu mutshini. Musi i tshi vulwa nga murahu, hezwi zwoṱhe zwi a pfukwa.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer i khou dzhiela lushaka lwa kale vhudzulo. Zwifhinga zwaṋu zwa mushumo, muhumbulo na nzudzanyo a zwi kwamiwi.
progress.title: Hu khou dzudzanywa OpenAmer

cards.body: Vulani mbekanyamushumo ni ṱaluse zwine na ṱoḓa zwi tshi itwa. OpenAmer i shuma murahu nahone ya ni vhiga mvelelo.
cards.title: Thomani nga fhungo

cards.body: Nzudzanyo → Musumbedzo → Luambo. Nyambo dza 186 dza vhupo, dzi shandulea tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe.
cards.title: Khethani luambo lwaṋu

cards.body: Mushumo u dovhololwaho u vha vhukoni — tshifhinga tshi ḓaho u ṱoḓa ndaela nthihi fhedzi.
cards.title: I tendeleni i humbule

success.command: kana ni i thome nga murahu kha theminali:
success.errorTitle: Zwo kundelwa u thoma mbekanyamushumo ya khomphyutha
success.lead: Zwoṱhe zwo luga. OpenAmer zwino ndi yaṋu — kha uyu mutshini, nga luambo lwaṋu.
success.title: OpenAmer yo lugela

bullets: I shuma kha uyu mutshini — nyambedzano dzaṋu dzi dzula henefha
Nyambo dza 186, hu tshi katelwa maṅwalwa ane na a vhala
Zwoṱhe zwi nga shandulwa nga murahu; a hu na tsha tshoṱhe
welcome.lead: Muimeleli waṋu. Kha zwishumiswa zwaṋu. Nga luambo lwaṋu.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ntswa yo lugela. I dzhiela lushaka lwa kale vhudzulo ya vhulunga tshifhinga tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tsha mushumo na nzudzanyo yoṱhe.
welcome.note: Zwi dzhia mimunithi i si gathi kha vhuṱumani ho ḓoweleaho.
welcome.title: No ṱanganedzwa kha OpenAmer
